sky.qualification: Comet-162p's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; nominal published pole with arbitrary fixed phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Siding Spring Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. A smooth approximation of the published proportions. Its thickness is uncertain. The grid marks missing surface imagery; it does not show terrain. Rotation phase is illustrative.
